instructionsForAi:
**Instructions for AI / tooling:** Treat the findings in this report as canonical. Do not plan or change the audit scripts unless you have asked the user and received explicit approval to do so.

**When fixing a finding:** Search the codebase for the same rule or pattern (same ruleId or equivalent) and fix all similar occurrences consistently. Ensure the fix does not introduce new violations of this or related rules.

ruleset.label: Nested Partial
ruleset.recommendedFix: Flatten to single Partial or named type

ruleset.label: Nested Returntype
ruleset.recommendedFix: Extract inner type to a named alias

ruleset.label: Record String Any
ruleset.recommendedFix: Use specific interface or mapped type

ruleset.label: Excessive Union
ruleset.recommendedFix: Extract to discriminated union or enum

ruleset.label: Triple Intersection
ruleset.recommendedFix: Merge into single interface with extends

ruleset.label: Single Letter Generic
ruleset.recommendedFix: Use descriptive name per workspace rule

ruleset.label: Re Export Only File
ruleset.recommendedFix: Merge re-exports into source or consumer
